bs.label: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities

Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability for merchandise credits and outstanding gift cards. Retail customers receive merchandise credits when products are returned and purchase gift cards that can be redeemed at a later date for merchandise; those unredeemed represent a liability of the entity because the revenue is being deferred.
